name: TanStack Query
covers: Rerail's own TanStack Query rules for query data read from the cache instead of copied into state, query functions that throw on failed responses, and browser queries that use a Route Handler instead of a Server Action.

rules.title: TanStack Query practice: read query data from the query, never copy it into useState
TanStack Query practice: a queryFn or mutationFn that calls fetch() throws when the response is not ok
TanStack Query practice: a queryFn that runs in the browser never calls a Server Action
